finalText:
Build passes clean now, exit code 0.

Found two real bugs behind the noise, both from the bundler's new options shape:

- `src/core/options.js` read `options.retries`, but the bump renamed that field to `retryCount` — threw on every build.
- `src/net/retryPolicy.js` treated an unset flag as invalid, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` instead of `false` — also threw.

Fixed both to match the new shapes. The rest was just deprecation/dedupe log spam, harmless.
